rules.title: Trash
rules.description: Permanently deletes the items in the Trash. This can’t be undone.

rules.title: Installers in Downloads
rules.description: DMG, PKG, XIP and ISO installers, usually no longer needed once the app is installed.

rules.title: Files in Downloads older than 90 days
rules.description: Check the list first: there may be files here you want to keep.

rules.title: iPhone / iPad backups
rules.description: Local device backups made by Finder. Make sure you have another backup (such as iCloud) before deleting.

rules.title: Mail attachment downloads
rules.description: Copies of attachments opened in Mail. The original messages are not affected.
